**Visual observations from test image:**
- Soybean leaf (upper surface visible) held by hand
- Numerous brown to reddish-brown lesions of varying sizes scattered across the leaf
- Lesions surrounded by yellow/chlorotic halos
- Many lesions have coalesced into larger irregular blotches
- Overall leaf showing significant yellowing/chlorosis

**Candidate analysis:**
- **Septoria brown spot**: Small, irregularly shaped, dark brown lesions on both surfaces; adjacent lesions coalesce into larger blotches; leaves turn yellow — matches well
- **Bacterial_Blight**: Angular reddish-brown lesions with yellow halos, centers fall out (tattered) — less likely, no tattering visible
- **Soybean_rust**: Lesions primarily on lower surface, small pustules — doesn't match upper surface view

**Reference comparison:** The Septoria reference shows the same pattern — dark brown irregular spots on yellowing leaves, coalescing into larger blotches, which matches perfectly with the test image.
